---
title: "moved_genes_ancestral_location"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---
This code is aimed to find preservation of the ancestral location of orthologous genes, which are moved between A. thaliana and A. lyrata. We test it by comparing orthologous genes nieghbors and preservation of their location between A. lyrata and C. rubella, as well as A. thaliana and C. rubella. The idea is that order needs to be preserved in A. lyrata vs C. rubella and disrupted in comparison of A. thaliana and C. rubella  
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```
## Read data
```{r}
# Define paths 
paths <- list(
  sim_thal_caps = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_athal_crubella/Crubella_RAM_v1_85_90.table",
  sim_lyr_caps = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_alyr_crubella/Crubella_RAM_v1_85_90.table",
  sim_thal_lyr = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_athal_31lyr/MN47_85_90.table",
  thal_gff = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff",
  caps_gff = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/capsella_genomes/Crubella_RAM_exon_v3.2.gff3",
  moved_genes = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_1to1_orth_moved_genes.csv",
  sim_thal_caps_cnv = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_athal_crubella/Crubella_RAM_v1_85_90.cnt",
  sim_lyr_caps_cnv = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/simsearch_alyr_crubella/Crubella_RAM_v1_85_90.cnt", 
  orth_thal_lyr = "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/coordinates_without_genes.csv"
)

# Read simsearch table and standardize coordinate column names
read_sim <- function(path) {
  dt <- fread(path)
  setnames(
    dt,
    old = c("sequence", "genome.chr", "beg.genome", "end.genome"),
    new = c("gene_id", "chr", "start", "end"),
    skip_absent = TRUE
  )

  dt[, `:=`(
    start = pmin(start, end),
    end = pmax(start, end))]
  dt[]
}

# Keep simsearch records only for query genes that have one Capsella copy.
# The .cnt file contains one row per query gene and columns such as
# lcl_Cr_1, ..., lcl_Cr_mt. Their row sum is the total Capsella copy number.
read_one_copy_sim <- function(sim_path, cnv_path) {
  cnv <- fread(cnv_path)
  setnames(cnv, 1, "gene_id")
  capsella_copy_columns <- grep("^lcl_Cr_", names(cnv), value = TRUE)
  if (length(capsella_copy_columns) == 0) {
    stop("No Capsella copy-number columns matching '^lcl_Cr_' were found.")
  }
  cnv[, total_capsella_copies := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),
      .SDcols = capsella_copy_columns]
  one_copy_gene_ids <- cnv[total_capsella_copies == 1, gene_id]
  sim <- read_sim(sim_path)
  sim[gene_id %in% one_copy_gene_ids]
}
```

```{r}
# Get one copy similar sequences 
sim_thal_caps_one_copy <- read_one_copy_sim(
  sim_path = paths$sim_thal_caps,
  cnv_path = paths$sim_thal_caps_cnv)

sim_lyr_caps_one_copy <- read_one_copy_sim(
  sim_path = paths$sim_lyr_caps,
  cnv_path = paths$sim_lyr_caps_cnv)
```
## Build 1:1 ortholog anchor tables (thaliana-lyrata)
```{r}
orth_thal_lyr <- fread(paths$orth_thal_lyr)
setnames(orth_thal_lyr, c("thal_id", "lyr_start", "lyr_end", "lyr_chr"))
thal_genes <- fread(paths$thal_gff)[V3 == "gene"]
thal_genes[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", V9)]
thal_genes[, gene_id := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
thal_genes <- thal_genes[, .(thal_chr = V1, thal_start = V4, thal_end = V5, gene_id)]
anchors <- merge(orth_thal_lyr, thal_genes, by.x = "thal_id", by.y = "gene_id")
anchors[, thal_mid := (thal_start + thal_end) / 2]
anchors[, lyr_mid  := (lyr_start  + lyr_end)  / 2]
```
## Overlap of the genomic coordinates (lyrata)
```{r}
# Get lyrata coordinates from capsella lyrata 
sim_lyr_caps_one_copy[, `:=`(
  lyr_scaffold = sub("^.*::([^:]+):.*$", "\\1", gene_id),
  lyr_q_start  = as.integer(sub("^.*:([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)\\([+-]\\)$", "\\1", gene_id)),
  lyr_q_end    = as.integer(sub("^.*:([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)\\([+-]\\)$", "\\2", gene_id))
)]
# Attach lyrata to single copy Capsela hit 
## Lyrata coordinate ranges in the thaliana–lyrata anchor table
lyr_query <- anchors[, .(
  thal_id,
  lyr_chr,
  lyr_start = as.integer(lyr_start),
  lyr_end   = as.integer(lyr_end)
)]

## Lyrata query ranges and their matched Capsella positions
caps_lyr_hits <- sim_lyr_caps_one_copy[, .(
  lyr_chr   = lyr_scaffold,
  lyr_start = as.integer(lyr_q_start),
  lyr_end   = as.integer(lyr_q_end),
  caps_chr_via_lyr = chr,
  caps_start_via_lyr = as.integer(start),
  caps_end_via_lyr = as.integer(end)
)]

setkey(caps_lyr_hits, lyr_chr, lyr_start, lyr_end)
## Match anchor coordinates to simsearch-query coordinates
lyr_matches <- foverlaps(
  x = lyr_query,
  y = caps_lyr_hits,
  by.x = c("lyr_chr", "lyr_start", "lyr_end"),
  by.y = c("lyr_chr", "lyr_start", "lyr_end"),
  type = "any",
  nomatch = NA
)
# How many matches we have?
lyr_match_summary <- lyr_matches[, .N, by = thal_id]
table(lyr_match_summary$N)


multiple_lyr_matches <- lyr_match_summary[N > 1]

lyr_matches[thal_id %in% multiple_lyr_matches$thal_id][order(thal_id)]
# Drop multiple matches in lyrata
keep_ids <- lyr_match_summary[N == 1, thal_id]
lyr_matches_one <- lyr_matches[
  thal_id %in% keep_ids & !is.na(caps_chr_via_lyr)
]
lyr_matches_one[, caps_mid_via_lyr :=
  (caps_start_via_lyr + caps_end_via_lyr) / 2
]
# Merge into anchors table lyrata-derived Capsella positions
anchors <- merge(
  anchors,
  lyr_matches_one[, .(
    thal_id,
    caps_chr_via_lyr,
    caps_start_via_lyr,
    caps_end_via_lyr,
    caps_mid_via_lyr
  )],
  by = "thal_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Merge into anchors thaliana-derived Capsella positions
sim_thal_caps_one_copy[, caps_mid_via_thal := (start + end) / 2]
anchors <- merge(
  anchors,
  sim_thal_caps_one_copy[, .(
    thal_id = gene_id,
    caps_chr_via_thal = chr,
    caps_start_via_thal = start,
    caps_end_via_thal = end,
    caps_mid_via_thal
  )],
  by = "thal_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

head(anchors[, .(thal_id, thal_chr, thal_mid, lyr_chr, lyr_mid,
                  caps_chr_via_thal, caps_mid_via_thal,
                  caps_chr_via_lyr, caps_mid_via_lyr)])
```
## Neighborhood preservation scoring
Are the genes that are close together in thaliana/lyrata also ordered consistently (left/right) in Capsella
```{r}
check_neighborhood <- function(mid, chr, k = 3) {
  n <- length(mid)
  n_present   <- integer(n)
  n_preserved <- integer(n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    idx <- (i - k):(i + k)
    idx <- idx[idx >= 1 & idx <= n & idx != i]
    idx <- idx[!is.na(chr[idx]) & !is.na(chr[i]) & chr[idx] == chr[i]]
    n_present[i] <- length(idx)
    if (length(idx) == 0) { n_preserved[i] <- NA; next }
    n_preserved[i] <- sum(sign(idx - i) == sign(mid[idx] - mid[i]))
  }
  data.table(n_present = n_present, n_preserved = n_preserved)
}
```
## Thaliana vs capsella hits order
```{r}
setorder(anchors, thal_chr, thal_mid)
res_thal_vs_caps <- anchors[, check_neighborhood(caps_mid_via_thal, caps_chr_via_thal, k = 3), by = thal_chr]

anchors[, `:=`(
  thal_caps_n_present   = res_thal_vs_caps$n_present,
  thal_caps_n_preserved = res_thal_vs_caps$n_preserved
)]
anchors[, thal_caps_frac_preserved := thal_caps_n_preserved / thal_caps_n_present]
```
## Lyrata order vs its own Capsella hit:
```{r}
setorder(anchors, lyr_chr, lyr_mid)

res_lyr_vs_caps <- anchors[, check_neighborhood(caps_mid_via_lyr, caps_chr_via_lyr, k = 3), by = lyr_chr]

anchors[, `:=`(
  lyr_caps_n_present   = res_lyr_vs_caps$n_present,
  lyr_caps_n_preserved = res_lyr_vs_caps$n_preserved
)]
anchors[, lyr_caps_frac_preserved := lyr_caps_n_preserved / lyr_caps_n_present]
```

```{r}
anchors[, thal_matches_ancestral := thal_caps_frac_preserved >= 0.5]
anchors[, lyr_matches_ancestral  := lyr_caps_frac_preserved  >= 0.5]

anchors[, polarization := fifelse(
  thal_matches_ancestral & !lyr_matches_ancestral, "lyrata_derived",
  fifelse(!thal_matches_ancestral & lyr_matches_ancestral, "thaliana_derived",
  fifelse(thal_matches_ancestral & lyr_matches_ancestral, "both_ancestral",
          "ambiguous")))]

table(anchors$polarization, useNA = "always")
## thaliana derived - Lyrata's order matches Capsella (ancestral), but thaliana's doesn't. This means thaliana is the one that rearranged at this locus
## lyrata derived - thaliana matches Capsella, lyrata doesn't. Lyrata rearranged, thaliana kept the ancestral orders
```
## Figures 
```{r}
## Build per-chromosome thaliana rank (window index for plotting)
setorder(anchors, thal_chr, thal_mid)
anchors[, thal_rank := seq_len(.N), by = thal_chr]

anchors[, is_focal := thal_id %in% moved_genes$gene_id]

plot_local_synteny <- function(anchors, focal_id, k = 3) {

  chr_focal <- anchors[thal_id == focal_id, thal_chr]
  if (length(chr_focal) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", focal_id, " — gene not found in anchors")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  win <- anchors[thal_chr == chr_focal]
  focal_rank <- win[thal_id == focal_id, thal_rank]
  win <- win[thal_rank %in% (focal_rank - k):(focal_rank + k)]
  win[, window_pos := thal_rank - focal_rank]   # 0 = focal gene, negative/positive = neighbors
  win[, point_type := fifelse(is_focal, "focal", "neighbor")]

  ## Long format: one row per (gene x comparison)
  long_dt <- rbindlist(list(
    win[, .(window_pos, point_type, comparison = "thaliana vs Capsella",
            y = caps_mid_via_thal, scaffold = caps_chr_via_thal)],
    win[, .(window_pos, point_type, comparison = "lyrata vs Capsella",
            y = caps_mid_via_lyr,  scaffold = caps_chr_via_lyr)],
    win[, .(window_pos, point_type, comparison = "thaliana vs lyrata",
            y = lyr_mid,           scaffold = lyr_chr)]
  ))

  if (all(is.na(long_dt$y))) {
    message("Skipping ", focal_id, " — no data in any comparison")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  long_dt[, pt_color := fcase(
    is.na(y),                  "no_hit",
    point_type == "focal",     "focal",
    default =                  "neighbor"
  )]

  p <- ggplot(long_dt, aes(x = window_pos, y = y)) +
    geom_line(data = long_dt[!is.na(y)], aes(group = comparison), color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(aes(color = pt_color), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ comparison, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(focal = "red", neighbor = "black", no_hit = "blue"),
      labels = c(focal = "focal", neighbor = "neighbor", no_hit = "no hit")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Position relative to focal gene (thaliana order)",
      y = "Genomic coordinate",
      color = "Gene type",
      title = paste("Local synteny:", focal_id)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)
}

## Run for all moved genes
for (gene in moved_genes$gene_id) {
  plot_local_synteny(anchors, gene, k = 3)
}
```






## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (thaliana)
```{r}
head(transposed_genes)
transposed_genes_thaliana <- transposed_genes %>% select(chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal,gene_id)
## Add +/- 10 KB to the both sides 
transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal-10000
transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal+10000
write.table(transposed_genes_thaliana,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/thaliana_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```

## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (capsella)
```{r}
# First calculate how many 1-1 orthologous genes defined in 3 capsella genomes
capsella_transposed_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_moved_gene_capsella_genomes.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
# How many genes have enteries in all 3 capsella genomes 
library(ggVennDiagram)

# function to check if a gene has a real hit (not NA, not "Not found")
has_hit <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x != "Not found"
library(dplyr)
set_grandiflora <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.grandiflora)) %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_rubella     <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.rubella))     %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_orientalis  <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.orientalis))  %>% pull(A.thaliana)

gene_sets <- list(
  C.grandiflora = set_grandiflora,
  C.rubella     = set_rubella,
  C.orientalis  = set_orientalis
)
```

```{r}
bar_dt <- data.frame(
  species = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella"),
  n_found = c(
    length(set_grandiflora),
    length(set_rubella),
    length(set_orientalis),
    length(Reduce(intersect, gene_sets))
  )
)

ggplot(bar_dt, aes(x = species, y = n_found, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = length(set_thaliana), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = length(set_thaliana) + 1,
           label = paste("total:", length(set_thaliana)), hjust = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_found), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "coral", "lightgreen", "purple")) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella")) +
  labs(
    x     = "Capsella species",
    y     = "Number of thaliana transposed genes with ortholog",
    title = "Ortholog presence of thaliana transposed genes in Capsella"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
## Get bed file for capsella rubella
```{r}
capsella_rub_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/capsella_genomes/Crubella_RAM_exon_v3.2.gff3")
colnames(capsella_rub_annotation) <- c("chromosome", "genome", "type", "start", "stop", "v6", "orientation", "v8", "id")
capsella_rub_annotation <- capsella_rub_annotation %>% filter(type == "gene")
capsella_rub_annotation$id <- gsub("ID=", "", capsella_rub_annotation$id)
## Select orthologous genes 
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- inner_join(capsella_rub_annotation,capsella_transposed_genes, by=c("id"="C.rubella"))
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start-10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop+10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates %>% select(chromosome,start,stop,A.thaliana)
write.table(capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/capsella_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```
